text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, write stories, and even compose music. AI-generated art can look surprisingly beautiful, and AI writing tools can produce clear, well-organized texts in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. We make choices that carry meaning. AI, on the other hand, learns patterns from existing data and combines them in new ways. It does not truly understand what it creates. So AI can be a useful tool, but human creativity remains special and irreplaceable.
